verdict.rationale: Evidence only implies custom control content. The framework-removal docs say controls persist when they contain "custom content", and Oneleet's Fieldwork page says you can "describe your control" and have AI agents collect and validate evidence. Nothing documents creating custom frameworks or defining custom tests and evidence requirements alongside built-in ones. Missing for 10: documented custom framework creation, explicit custom control creation workflow, user-defined automated tests, configurable evidence requirements, independent corroboration.
